Two distinct 'Toilet Seats' categories exist at different URLs with different breadcrumbs/counts (fixtures-and-fittings/toilet-seats 171 vs bathroom-tech-and-appliances/bathroom/toilet-seats 71) - both genuinely different URLs, both recorded per dedup rule 28. bathroom-splashbacks (17) included as bathroom wall fixture per site's direct Bathroom-hub placement (rule 23/24), not explicitly named in category list but clearly bathroom-specific hardware, not decor.
